instruction: Please configure Chrome to enable the 'Do Not Track' feature to send a request to websites not to track my browsing activity.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling Do Not Track in Chrome privacy settings. Uses existing get_enable_do_not_track getter which reads Chrome Preferences file and checks the 'enable_do_not_track' boolean field. Returns 'true' when enabled. Evaluator verifies the setting is enabled after browser restart.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing get_enable_do_not_track getter from chrome.py line 1263, which returns 'true' when enable_do_not_track is set in Chrome Preferences.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the Do Not Track setting from Chrome Preferences file (enable_do_not_track field)
Metric (exact_match) appropriately compares the boolean-like string result
Expected value 'true' semantically matches what the getter returns when Do Not Track is enabled
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted to disk before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the core requirement (Do Not Track enabled in Chrome settings)
Runtime feasibility confirmed: getter can access standard Chrome Preferences file location
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider increasing postconfig sleep from 3 to 5 seconds for slower systems to ensure Chrome fully restarts and writes preferences
Minor robustness: could add validation that Chrome restart succeeded before reading preferences, though current implementation fails gracefully
